# 2 Baruch Chapter 55 — Disagreement Log
**Arbiter:** SOPHIA | **In council with:** EMET, LOGOS, PNEUMA
**Source:** Syriac MS (Codex Ambrosianus 7a1) | **Section:** The Cloud and Waters Vision
**Date:** 2026-03-17

---

## 55:1 — angel's title

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "the-angel Ramiel who-presides over-true-visions" |
| LOGOS | "the angel Ramiel, who presides over true visions" |
| PNEUMA | "the angel Ramiel, who oversees true visions" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Presides over' (Syriac: d-qayem 'al) carries the sense of official authority over a domain; 'oversees' is an acceptable paraphrase but LOGOS is more precise.

---

## 55:8 — reason for Baruch's election

| Translator | Rendering |
|---|---|
| EMET | "because-you-are-righteous and-obedient-to-the-fear-of-the-Mighty-One" |
| LOGOS | "because you are righteous and obedient to the fear of the Mighty One" |
| PNEUMA | "because you are righteous and obedient to the fear of the Almighty" |

**SOPHIA's resolution:** SOPHIA adopted LOGOS. 'Mighty One' (Syriac: Taqqifa) is a specific divine title used in 2 Baruch that should be preserved consistently; 'Almighty' is a different title.

---
